slug: ydb-core
description: Use for YDB introductions and comparisons with other databases; connection strings, authentication, service-account credentials and credential environment variables; local Docker; SDK/package/integration selection; CLI discovery and safe namespace operations with `ydb scheme` (inspection, creation, removal, permissions, confirmation); client-side balancing, session lifecycle under rolling restart, and general deadline, cancellation, or retry-budget guidance outside application-query audits. Applies to explanatory questions as well as setup tasks. Triggers include `grpcs://`, `grpc://`, `ydb --help`, `ydb version`, `ydb config`, `ydb discovery`, `ydb scheme`, `balancers.RandomChoice`, `balancers.PreferNearestDC`, `ydb.WithBalancer`, `session-balancer`, `BAD_SESSION`, and `shutdownHint`. Use ydb-table for SQL, query execution, schema design for queries, and application query-code audits; use specialist skills for topic or coordination tasks.

slug: ydb-docs
description: Find and verify official documentation for the YDB database (СУБД YDB) on ydb.tech. Load only when the requested documentation concerns YDB itself or a YDB-specific part of a mixed question. Covers YDB source links, citations, fact checking, and lookup plans without network access. Can support another YDB skill when documentation is needed. Supports Russian or English and requested YDB product versions.

slug: ydb-table
description: Read this skill before answering YDB SQL/YQL questions or writing, explaining or running queries, even short syntax or familiar snippets. Covers pagination, DECLARE, typed parameters, schema/primary-key/partition design, EXPLAIN, `ydb sql` and SQL-dialect conversion. Local deployment, connection/authentication setup, SDK selection and general deadline/retry policy belong to ydb-core unless the request includes a query, schema or existing SDK code/configuration to review; naming a client language alone does not make setup a code audit. Also use to review existing YDB Go SDK, C++ ydb-cpp-sdk, Java JDBC/Hibernate/Spring Data JPA or Python FloatVector code: queries, streaming, retries, transactions, driver/balancer initialization and deadline/cancellation behavior. Read the matching language rules before judging code. General YDB introductions/comparisons belong to ydb-core; standalone documentation lookup belongs to ydb-docs. YQL on YT without YDB is outside scope.
